name: Argent
description: Gives AI coding assistants control of iOS simulators, Android emulators, TVs, and Electron apps to tap, debug, profile, and replay flows, for mobile and desktop app developers.

skills.name: App Interaction
skills.description: Taps, swipes, types, and presses hardware buttons on simulators, emulators, TVs, and Electron apps.

skills.name: Record and Replay Flows
skills.description: Records a UI path once and replays it deterministically as a bug repro or smoke test.

skills.name: Visual Regression
skills.description: Compares a baseline against a live capture with OCR- and font-aware diffing.

skills.name: Performance Profiling
skills.description: Profiles renders, CPU hotspots, and hangs through Hermes, React DevTools, Xcode Instruments, and Perfetto.

skills.name: App Debugging
skills.description: Inspects logs, network traffic, native and React trees, and evaluates JavaScript in the running app.
